sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach remain top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, though they've won only one of their last two outings (a draw preceded that loss). Alsager Town are bottom of the division with just 4 points and have managed only one win in ten games, so this represents a strong opportunity for the leaders to return to winning ways.
divisionWide: The chase for the title tightens as second-placed Stafford Town host bottom-half Dawley Town on Saturday, with the Stafford outfit looking to close a two-point gap on leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth, currently third with 19 points, entertain Eccleshall in a fixture between two of the division's stronger sides—Eccleshall sit fifth and have won their last outing despite a mixed run overall. Wolverhampton Casuals (4th, 19 points) are in good form with three wins in their last five and will face Wednesfield Community at home on Saturday before a midweek clash at Brereton Social on Wednesday 7 October. In-form Bilston Town (5th, 17 points) visit Foley Meir in a battle of mid-table sides. Barnton entertain Shawbury United in a clash between mid-table teams; Shawbury are in severe trouble with six consecutive losses. Market Drayton Town (10th) host New Mills (8th), both searching for consistency. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a bottom-half encounter between two struggling sides, while Crewe host Allscott Heath in another fixture between lower-division teams. Brereton Social's Saturday fixture against Widnes Town pits one of the division's form-challenged teams against the basement club, who have won just twice all season and haven't tasted victory in their last five games.
